name: breadcrumb
description: A source-owned shadcn-style Breadcrumb navigation trail for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational nav trail (Breadcrumb/BreadcrumbList/BreadcrumbItem/BreadcrumbLink/BreadcrumbPage/BreadcrumbSeparator/BreadcrumbEllipsis), matching upstream's own non-interactive implementation. BreadcrumbSeparator defaults to a ChevronRight icon; BreadcrumbEllipsis renders the owned Lucide Ellipsis re-export (this icon set's current name for upstream's MoreHorizontalIcon, which Lucide itself renamed).
documentation.accessibility: The root is `<nav aria-label="breadcrumb">`; the current page carries `aria-current="page"` and `role="link"`/`aria-disabled="true"` (it is not a real link); separators and the ellipsis are `aria-hidden`/`role="presentation"` (`registry/ui/breadcrumb.rs`).
documentation.keyboard: `BreadcrumbLink` renders a native `<a>`, so Tab/Enter follow ordinary link semantics; there is no component-specific keyboard handling beyond that.
